item.title: Nurses, FNM Leadership, Baby Death Investigation
item.ns0:title: Nurses, FNM Leadership, Baby Death Investigation
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, healthcare conditions on the Family Islands come under intense scrutiny as nurses union leaders demand urgent action over clinic mold and transport struggles in Bimini and Abaco. In Parliament, the Davis administration addresses key findings from the Fiscal Responsibility Council's budget report, while Opposition Leader Michael Pintard ramps up criticism over recent undercover U.S. DEA operations. Investigators probe the tragic death of a one-month-old baby girl brought unresponsive to a local police station, as thousands of civil servants cast their ballots in a crucial union leadership election. Plus, Western Air halts service to North Eleuthera over deteriorating runway conditions, and we bring you the latest in local sports and weather, so tune in to catch up on all these top stories!
